description.value: A full-service waterfront resort set on a secluded stretch of Okanagan Lake shoreline, roughly midway between Penticton and Kelowna in the heart of BC wine country. Accommodation is offered in fully outfitted suite-style rooms with gourmet kitchens, and on-site facilities include iKhaya Day Spa, boat rentals, and complimentary kayak and stand-up paddleboard use. It sits along the popular Naramata Bench and South Okanagan cycling corridor, making it a comfortable base for multi-day touring cyclists.
